name: Hawaii

law.summary: Wastewater owners must report spills, overflows and discharges to the DOH Clean Water Branch (HAR 11-62 Appendix B); the Department then posts a public advisory with signs and on its eha-cloud portal and keeps it until cancelled. No operator duty to tell the public directly was confirmed.

citations.title: Responses for wastewater spills, overflows and discharges
citations.who: owner or agent of the wastewater system

regulator_report.deadline: immediately by phone per practice; written report (deadline not read)
regulator_report.cite: HAR 11-62 Appendix B; HAR 11-55 NPDES standard conditions

bills_and_cases: Honolulu wastewater global consent decree (2010; search_only)

statewide_feed.latency: minutes to hours (DOH posts the advisory when notified)
statewide_feed.history: 2023-01 to date in the API's newest 500; 1,898 events in total
statewide_feed.start_end: advisory posted and closed dates; spill start/end only in text
statewide_feed.notes: Accept: application/json is required; staff emails in createdBy/updatedBy must be dropped.

sso.notes: Locations are text; geocode the 'Location:' line or the title.

beaches.program: DOH Clean Water Branch beach monitoring (BEACH Act)
beaches.notes: Beach Advisory, Beach Notification and Brown Water Advisory are in the same API.

habs.notes: Freshwater HABs are not a significant program in Hawaii; leptospirosis advice is attached to stream advisories.

barriers.what: No terms stated for the undocumented CWB API
barriers.note: Ask DOH for permission or documentation.

barriers.what: Operator-side public notice not required; DOH is the only channel

subscriptions.name: DOH Clean Water Branch advisory email notifications
subscriptions.what: Beach advisories, brown water advisories and sewage spills, filterable by island

readiness.rationale: One statewide JSON endpoint with the authority's own sewage-spill advisories, posted and closed dates and advice; geocoding of text locations is the only real work.

owner_questions: Brown Water Advisories (rain runoff, 280 of 500 events) are not sewage reports: show them as a separate advisory category, or only as rain context?
Geocode text locations (no coordinates in the API) by rules, with a model only to classify, never to place?
Subscribe to the DOH CWB email notifications?
surprise: Hawaii, with no CSOs and no SOBE data, has the cleanest feed in the region: the Health Department's own spill and beach advisories as JSON from one public endpoint, open and closed, posted within minutes.
